disclaimer: Context only — an AI reading of the radar's own deterministic output, not a signal. It feeds no score or allocation, can be wrong or overconfident, and every claim cites the radar evidence it is based on. Graded against the tape over time; treat as odds, not a forecast.

assessments.rationale: The strongest signal is news flow (z=3.5) [P3] with velocity 9.6 and acceleration 0.455 [P5] plus wholly unscheduled share (1.0) [P5] — this is how new narratives get born. But real-activity breadth is thin: the other six sources are all near zero or negative (Federal contracts -0.334, pre-award solicitations -0.329) [P3], and fused acceleration 1.831 is driven by news plus two political sources (Congress net-buy 1.369, lobbying ramp 1.236) [P3]. That is attention, not yet industrial scale. Continuity is poor: 60-day relative strength vs SPY is -0.2087 (z -3.457) [P4], i.e. price is meaningfully lagging despite the narrative heat — consistent with the radar's POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE [P1] but also with a story not yet believed by capital. Lifecycle 'emerging' [P1] means this could become an ENTER if federal and pre-award activity turn positive; right now it is MONITOR.
assessments.rationale_zh: 最强信号是新闻流(z=3.5)[P3]，速度9.6、加速度0.455[P5]，且全部为非计划性发布(1.0)[P5]——这是新叙事诞生的典型模式。但真实活动广度很薄：其余六个来源均接近零或为负(联邦合同-0.334、预授标征集-0.329)[P3]，融合加速度1.831主要由新闻加两个政治来源驱动(国会净买入1.369、游说升温1.236)[P3]。这是关注度，而非产业规模。连续性很差：60日相对强弱为-0.2087(z -3.457)[P4]，即价格明显滞后于叙事热度——与雷达的正向背离[P1]一致，但同时也说明资本尚未相信这个故事。生命周期'新兴'[P1]意味着若联邦和预授标活动转正，可升级为ENTER；目前为MONITOR。
assessments.rationale_plain: News about the space economy is picking up sharply — nearly ten pieces a week, all of them unscheduled, which suggests genuine new interest rather than routine releases. But the underlying industrial activity isn't there yet: federal contract activity and early-stage solicitations are flat to slightly down, so for now this is mostly attention from news coverage and a couple of political actors. Price has not followed at all — the sector has lagged the broader market over the last two months — so money hasn't believed the story yet. The right posture is to watch and wait for actual federal or pre-award activity to turn up before committing.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 太空经济相关的新闻报道正在明显增多——每周接近十条，而且全部是非计划性发布，说明这是真实的新关注而非例行消息。但背后的产业活动还没跟上：联邦合同和早期招标活动持平甚至略降，目前主要是新闻报道和少数政治参与者在推动关注。价格完全没跟——过去两个月该板块明显跑输大盘——说明资金尚未相信这个故事。正确做法是继续观察，等联邦合同或招标活动真正起来后再介入。
assessments.dissent: News flow with zero scheduled share and strong acceleration can itself be a leading indicator of coming contracts — journalists call sources before anything is filed, and Congress net-buy with lobbying ramp may signal imminent earmarks or policy changes. If price catches up on the next round of awards, MONITOR will have been too slow.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Federal contracts z or pre-award solicitations z turns positive within 30-60 days while price relative strength stops deteriorating.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: News flow acceleration decays and price continues to lag for another 30 days with no improvement in federal or pre-award activity.

assessments.name: Space Economy

assessments.rationale: The radar [P1] flags POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE with a forming lifecycle, and the real-activity vs price divergence z of 2.446 [P2] suggests activity is currently ahead of price. However, per-source detail is narrow: the signal is carried almost entirely by Gov contracts z=2.258 and, to a lesser degree, Congress net-buy z=1.277, while Lobbying z=0.115 and 8-K z=0.449 are near noise [P3]. So the breadth of the 'real' signal is thin despite fused accel of 2.198 [P3]. Price has not confirmed: 60-day relative strength vs the market is -0.0521, z -1.243, direction negative [P4], meaning the sector has been underperforming while the activity signal points upward — the definition of a divergence that could be early but has not yet been validated by flow. No news leg [P5] means the narrative is not yet public. Given covered members CHTR, CMCSA, DIS, T, VZ [P6], the Gov contracts spike could plausibly be one or two large awards to a single telecom or media company rather than a sector-wide theme, which would lower durability. Overall the activity is real but narrow, the lifecycle is only 'forming', and price is still negative — consistent with MONITOR rather than ENTER.
assessments.rationale_zh: 雷达[P1]显示正背离且生命周期处于形成阶段，实际活动与价格背离的z值为2.446[P2]，表明活动信号领先于价格。但分来源看信号较窄：主要由政府合同z=2.258和国会净买入z=1.277驱动，而游说z=0.115和8-K文件z=0.449接近噪声[P3]。因此尽管融合加速度为2.198[P3]，实际信号的广度有限。价格尚未确认：60日相对大盘强度为-0.0521，z值-1.243，方向为负[P4]，说明该板块在活动信号向上的同时表现落后——这是一个可能尚早、尚未被资金流验证的背离。无新闻催化[P5]意味着该叙事尚未公开。考虑到覆盖成分CHTR、CMCSA、DIS、T、VZ[P6]，政府合同激增可能只是某一家电信或媒体公司获得的一两笔大额订单，而非板块性主题，这会降低持续性。总体来看活动真实但偏窄，生命周期仅为形成期，价格仍为负——符合观望而非入场。
assessments.rationale_plain: There are early signs of quiet activity picking up in the communication-services space — federal contract awards and some congressional buying are running ahead of where the sector's share prices are. But the signal is not broad: it is mostly coming from government contracts, with other sources like lobbying and corporate filings barely moving. Price has not followed yet; the sector has actually been underperforming the broader market over the last couple of months. That combination — a narrow, early real-world signal with price still negative — means this is worth watching, not buying yet. If the government-contract activity turns out to be a sector-wide pattern and price starts to recover, the picture changes.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 通信服务板块出现了一些早期的、尚未反映在股价里的真实活动迹象——政府合同授予和部分国会买入行为领先于板块股价。但这个信号并不广：主要来自政府合同，游说和公司申报等其他来源几乎没有动静。价格也还没有跟随，该板块过去两个月实际上跑输大盘。窄而早的真实信号加上仍然为负的价格，意味着目前值得观察而不是买入。如果政府合同活动后来证明是板块性的，并且价格开始回升，判断就会改变。
assessments.dissent: The strongest case against MONITOR is that POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE with a z of 2.446 [P2] and fused acceleration of 2.198 [P3] is exactly the setup that historically precedes sector rotation; waiting for price confirmation at a negative z of -1.243 [P4] risks entering after the move is obvious. Gov contracts z=2.258 [P3] is a magnitude rarely seen without follow-through, and the absence of news [P5] means the trade is not yet crowded — the radar may be flashing ENTER before price, and MONITOR could be too conservative.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Within 4-6 weeks, 60-day relative strength vs the market turns positive (z > 0) while Gov contracts and Congress net-buy z-scores remain above 1.5, and at least one additional source (lobbying or 8-K) rises above z=1.0.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Gov contracts z-score mean-reverts below 1.0 within 2-3 weeks and Congress net-buy fades toward zero, with no pickup in lobbying or 8-K activity, while relative strength remains negative.

assessments.name: Communication Services (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: [P1] marks the theme as POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE in a forming lifecycle; [P2] shows activity ahead of price (z=1.389). But the activity breadth is thin: [P3] shows only 2 strong sources (Gov contracts z=1.196, Lobbying ramp z=1.107) out of 4, with Congress net-buy slightly negative (-0.213) and 8-Ks flat (0.245). So the real-activity signal is positive but half-hearted. Price confirms nothing: [P4] relative strength is -1.22% vs the market, z=-0.679 — the sector is still falling behind, consistent with a forming (early) thesis but not yet confirmation. [P5] adds no news leg, meaning the market has not discovered this. Durability is the best of the three axes because the two active sources are policy-flows (contracts, lobbying) which tend to persist over months; but with only ADM and SYY as covered names [P6], the narrative is too narrow to trade yet.
assessments.rationale_zh: [P1] 显示该主题处于正背离的形成期；[P2] 也表明实际活动领先于价格（z=1.389）。但 [P3] 的活动宽度偏薄：四个来源中只有两个较强（政府合同 z=1.196、游说升温 z=1.107），国会净买入为负（-0.213），8-K 事件平淡（0.245）。价格面尚无确认：[P4] 相对大盘跌 1.22%，z=-0.679，板块仍在跑输。耐久性相对最好，因为两个活跃来源属于政策流，持续性通常较强；但 [P6] 覆盖标的仅 ADM、SYY，叙事过于狭窄，暂不宜交易。
assessments.rationale_plain: There are early signs of quiet activity building under the consumer staples sector: government contract awards and lobbying spend are picking up among a couple of large food and distribution companies, running ahead of where the sector's stock prices currently sit. But the sector itself has still been trailing the broader market, and the flow of company filings and Congressional trading activity do not yet corroborate the story. With only two names showing the signal and no public news attention yet, this looks more like groundwork than a tradeable trend — keep an eye on it rather than stepping in.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 必需消费品板块下方有初步的静默活动迹象：少数食品和分销龙头的政府订单与游说支出正在升温，且领先于这些公司股价的当前位置。但板块整体仍跑输大盘，公司公告流和国会交易活动也尚未印证这条线索。目前只有两家公司呈现信号，媒体层面也还没有任何关注，这更像是在酝酿而还不是可交易的趋势，宜观望而非入场。
assessments.dissent: The strongest case against MONITOR is that policy-related flows (Gov contracts and lobbying) are structurally slower-moving and often peak before public attention; the POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE state in [P1] with activity ahead of price [P2] could mean the market is about to catch up quickly. Under that view, waiting for price confirmation [P4] to turn positive risks buying after the move; an ENTER at low conviction could capture the early wedge. The counter is that the sample ([P6] only two names) is too small to distinguish a sector theme from idiosyncratic business development at ADM and SYY.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Within 6-8 weeks, 60-day relative strength vs the market turns positive (z>0) without a corresponding drop in Gov contracts or lobbying z-scores; or per-source breadth expands to at least 3 of 4 sources with positive z.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Gov contracts and lobbying z-scores fall below +1.0 in the next 4 weeks; or relative strength remains negative for 8+ weeks despite continued activity — implying the policy flows are not sector-wide or are already reflected in price.

assessments.name: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: The single strong real-activity signal is Gov contracts (Quiver) at z=3.341, which is the dominant input to the fused accel of 3.285 across 4 sources [P3]. However, the other three sources are weak-to-negative: Congress net-buy z=-0.626, Lobbying z=0.452, and 8-K material events z=-1.054 [P3]. This is a one-legged narrative — real breadth is thin. Durability is questionable because the high fused score rests on a single federal-contract print rather than a broad ramp; nothing indicates the Gov-contract flow is recurring or accelerating, and 8-K activity is actually negative [P3]. Continuity is mixed: the real-activity vs price divergence is positive (z=0.534), meaning activity is slightly ahead of price [P2], and the radar shows POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE in forming stage [P1]. But the 60-day relative strength vs SPY is only 0.0703 (z 0.487), essentially flat, and there is no news leg [P4][P5], so price has not yet begun to confirm the activity signal. Covered names are CSCO, DELL, HPE, MCHP [P6].
assessments.rationale_zh: 唯一强劲的真实活动信号是政府合同（Quiver）z=3.341，这是4个来源融合加速值3.285的主要驱动 [P3]。但其他三个来源均偏弱或为负：国会净买入z=-0.626、游说z=0.452、8-K重大事件z=-1.054 [P3]。这是一条单腿逻辑，实际宽度不足。持续性存疑，因为融合高分依赖单一的联邦合同数据，而非广泛上升；没有迹象表明政府合同流是持续或加速的，且8-K活动实际为负 [P3]。连续性方面喜忧参半：真实活动与价格的正向背离（z=0.534）意味着活动略领先于价格 [P2]，雷达处于形成阶段的正向背离 [P1]，但60日相对强度仅为0.0703（z 0.487），基本持平，且无新闻推动 [P4][P5]，价格尚未开始确认活动信号。覆盖标的为CSCO、DELL、HPE、MCHP [P6]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Federal contract awards flowing to a cluster of hardware and semiconductor firms have jumped sharply, running well above the pace of other measurable signals like congressional trading, lobbying, or major corporate filings. That real-world activity is slightly ahead of price, but the market has not moved much yet — shares are roughly flat relative to the broader market over the past three months, and no news cycle has picked the story up. The surge rests mostly on one federal-contract print rather than a broad-based pickup across sources, so it may be a one-off reorder rather than the start of a durable trend. The right posture is to watch for either price confirmation or a second contract wave before committing.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 流向一批硬件和半导体公司的联邦合同订单出现大幅跳升，远高于国会交易、游说或重大公司公告等其他可衡量信号的水平。这一真实活动略领先于价格，但市场尚未明显反应——过去三个月这些股票相对大盘基本持平，也没有新闻周期跟进这个故事。这一激增主要依赖单一的联邦合同数据，而非多来源的广泛回升，因此可能是一次性订单而非持久趋势的开始。正确的做法是等待价格确认或第二波合同出现后再介入。
assessments.dissent: The Gov-contract z=3.341 is a genuinely extreme print and, if it represents a new multi-quarter federal program (e.g., infrastructure or defense hardware refresh), the other signals may simply lag. Congress net-buy and lobbying can trail a contract award by months, meaning the single-source spike could be the leading edge of a durable cycle, not a one-off. In that case, waiting for broad confirmation would mean entering after the easy move.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Within 4-6 weeks, price relative strength vs the broad market turns clearly positive (z > 1.0) and the Gov-contract series posts at least one more high-z print, indicating a recurring flow rather than a single contract.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Within 4-6 weeks, Gov-contract z falls below 1.0 with no follow-on award, 8-K activity remains negative or worsens, and price relative strength stays flat or declines — confirming the spike was a one-off.

assessments.name: Non-AI Tech & Hardware

assessments.rationale: Real-activity signal is deeply negative: fused acceleration is only 0.514 across 4 sources [P3], and 8-K material events z=-3.11 and Congress net-buy z=-1.372 show institutional/regulatory activity at multi-sigma lows [P3]. Activity is not accelerating but rather fading (lifecycle: fading) [P1]. Price is running ahead of activity: 60-day relative strength z=3.123 vs SPY [P4] while the divergence z is -4.284, meaning price has outperformed despite activity collapsing [P2]. This is a classic negative divergence: price momentum without real-world support. Radar state NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE confirms the narrative is weaker than price suggests [P1]. No news leg [P5] means no fresh catalyst to reconcile the gap; the theme is running on memory of past strength, not current flows.
assessments.rationale_zh: 真实活动信号深度为负：四个来源的融合加速度仅为0.514 [P3]，8-K重大事件z=-3.11、国会净买入z=-1.372，机构和监管活动均处于多西格玛低点 [P3]。活动不仅没有加速，反而在消退（生命周期：消退）[P1]。价格跑在活动前面：60日相对强度z=3.123 [P4]，而活动与价格背离z=-4.284，说明价格在活动崩塌的同时跑赢大盘 [P2]。这是典型的负背离：价格动量缺乏真实世界支撑。雷达状态为负背离，确认叙事弱于价格所示 [P1]。无新闻腿 [P5] 意味着没有新催化剂弥合这一差距；该主题在依赖过去的强势记忆，而非当前资金流。
assessments.rationale_plain: Behind the recent price strength in memory and storage chips, the actual activity is drying up. Corporate filings, Congressional trading, and regulatory work are all running well below normal, and the gap between price and activity is at an extreme. The market has been bid up without any real-world follow-through, and there is no fresh news to change that. This looks like a theme being held up by momentum rather than on-the-ground demand, so it is better to stand aside until the real activity starts to catch up.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 在存储芯片近期价格走强的背后，实际活动正在枯竭。公司披露、国会交易和监管工作都远低于正常水平，价格与活动之间的差距处于极端状态。市场在没有真实世界跟进的情况下被推高，而且没有新消息来改变这一点。这看起来像是一个靠惯性而非实际需求支撑的主题，所以最好先观望，等真实活动开始跟上再考虑。
assessments.dissent: The strongest counter-argument is that 60-day relative strength is extremely high (z=3.123) [P4]; if this is driven by genuine supply constraints or AI-driven HBM demand not yet captured in the 4 tracked sources [P3], the negative divergence could be a data-coverage gap rather than a genuine fade. A sharp earnings beat from MU or a large new HBM contract could flip the activity signal quickly.

falsifiable_check.confirm: If 8-K material events or lobbying ramp z-scores turn positive in the next 2-4 weeks AND the 60-day relative strength z falls below 1.5, the theme is genuinely fading and the AVOID call is correct.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: If 8-K z rises above +1.0 and/or a major new HBM/memory supply agreement is announced within 30 days while price continues to hold relative strength z > 2, the activity signal was too narrow and the theme still has legs.

assessments.name: Memory, HBM & Storage

assessments.rationale: All three real-activity sources are essentially flat or slightly negative: Congress net-buy z=-0.062, Lobbying ramp z=-0.12, 8-K material events z=-0.104 [P3]. There is no breadth or magnitude to the signal — only 3 sources firing weakly. The activity-vs-price divergence is deeply negative at z=-3.03, meaning price is running far ABOVE activity [P2]. Radar state is NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE and lifecycle fading [P1], with no news leg to extend the narrative [P5]. Price momentum is strong over 60d (+24.3% relative, z 2.93) [P4], but this is a classic fading/priced-late setup: price strength without activity confirmation. The only thing 'strong' here is performance that already happened.
assessments.rationale_zh: 三项真实活动信号几乎全部走平或轻微为负：国会净买入 z 值 -0.062，游说活动 z 值 -0.12，8-K 重大事件 z 值 -0.104 [P3]。信号来源仅 3 个，且均无强度、无广度。活动与价格之间的背离程度很深，z 值为 -3.03，表明价格已远超真实活动 [P2]。雷达状态为负向背离，生命周期处于衰退 [P1]，新闻事件也未能延续叙事 [P5]。60 日相对表现很强（+24.3%，z 值 2.93）[P4]，但这是典型的价格已在没有活动确认的情况下先行透支的形态。唯一'强'的部分是已经发生的涨幅。
assessments.rationale_plain: The software names covered here have already rallied hard — about 24% relative to the market over two months — but there is no real-world activity behind that move. Congressional buying, lobbying, and material corporate disclosures are all flat or slightly down from their own norms. The narrative is running on price momentum alone, and momentum without underlying activity is usually late-stage. Best to avoid chasing this.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 这批软件公司在过去两个月里已经涨了不少，相对大盘大约多涨了 24%，但这轮上涨背后没有任何实际世界活动的支撑。国会买入、游说活动、公司重大信息披露都处于走平或微降的状态。这轮叙事完全靠价格惯性在推动，而缺乏实际活动支撑的惯性行情，通常已经到了后期。最好避免追入。
assessments.dissent: The strongest counter-argument is that even a fading narrative can continue to rally on mechanical flows, and 60-day relative strength of +24.3% (z 2.93) [P4] is not trivial — clients or index rebalancing could force buying into these names into quarter-end, pushing price even higher from these levels before any reversal. Additionally, these are mega-cap software names (ADBE, CRM, INTU, MDB) with secular cash flows that may not need alt-data to maintain their trajectory; the real-activity sensors may simply be blind to consumer/enterprise demand signals that do not surface in Congress or 8-K filings. AVOID may miss a final leg.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Relative strength vs market turns negative within 20 trading days AND any of the three activity sources prints z < -0.5, confirming the fade.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: At least two of the three activity sources flip positive (z > +0.5) within 20 trading days, and the group makes a new 60-day relative high, indicating the sensors were wrong and activity is re-accelerating.

rotation.summary: Rotation is leaving mature AI infrastructure/concentrated-tech leadership and fading speculative GLP-1/crypto/uranium pockets, while early real-activity-driven accumulation is emerging in Space Economy, Communication Services, Consumer Staples, and Non-AI Tech — but not yet confirmed by lifecycle maturation.
rotation.summary_zh: 轮动正在撤离成熟的 AI 基础设施和集中式科技领军板块，同时投机性的 GLP-1、加密货币和铀矿等子主题在消退；而航天经济、通信服务、必需消费和非 AI 科技等领域出现了由实际活动驱动的早期积累，但尚未得到生命周期成熟的确认。
accumulate: Space Economy (state=POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=emerging) — real activity leads price in an emerging space, early accumulation zone
Communication Services Equal-Weight (state=POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=forming) — sector-level breadth confirming via activity-price divergence
Consumer Staples Equal-Weight (state=POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=forming) — defensive rotation grounded in activity, not just flight-to-safety
Non-AI Tech & Hardware (state=POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=forming) — hardware outside AI showing activity confirmation
reduce: Magnificent Seven (state=CONFIRMED_DOWN, lifecycle=fading) — price and activity both rolling over; avoid catching knife
AI Neoclouds & HPC Hosting (state=CONFIRMED_DOWN, lifecycle=fading) — activity confirmed down, late-cycle unwind
GLP-1 & Obesity (state=NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=fading) — price running ahead of fading activity
Memory, HBM & Storage (state=NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, lifecycle=fading) — activity fading faster than price
Crypto & Digital Assets (state=CONFIRMED_DOWN, lifecycle=fading) — both activity and price confirmed down
Uranium & Nuclear Fuel / Nuclear & SMR Power / Critical Minerals (state=CONFIRMED_DOWN, lifecycle=fading) — thematic rollover with activity confirmation
watch: The QUIET cluster around AI Software, Power Grid, Data-Center Power, Robotics, and Quantum — which one breaks out of quiet into confirmed-up would signal the next leadership leg
Financials, AI Semiconductors, and Semiconductor Equipment remain CONFIRMED_UP with confirming lifecycle — watch for whether they roll over or extend
Travel & Experiences and Big Pharma showing NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE — a reversal to positive divergence would invalidate the reduce call
Whether Communication Services and Non-AI Tech transition from POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE to CONFIRMED_UP (lifecycle from forming to mature)
